sceneFaultyBattery2.scene: As you're getting ready to leave, you realize that again, your car will not start.

answers.name: Consult your mechanic
answers.dialogue: John immediatly recognizes the situation. He instructs you to purchase a new battery for your car.

answers.name: Look at your dashboard

sceneWinterDischarge.scene: You decide not to drive your car all winter break, it's been really cold and you forgot to start the car. Now when you go to start it nothing happens.

answers.name: It's because I forgot to start it in the cold and now my battery is dead
It's because my oil froze and is now gumming the inside of my engine
answers.dialogue: In Oregon it never gets cold enough to "freeze" the oil, oil freezes at a minimum of -4°F

answers.name: It's because I forgot to change the carburetor filter and now it's not getting oil
answers.dialogue: This answer has many things wrong with it, for one carburetors don't have a filter inside, mostly they have an air intake filter outside or a fuel filter also outside of the carburetor. Another flaw is that the carburetor doesn't use oil or pump oil anywhere. Also lastly most cars have switched to electronic fuel injection.

answers.name: It's because I forgot to change the spark plugs in my diesel
answers.dialogue: Diesel engines do not use traditional spark plugs in the engine, but they use glow plugs due to how a diesel engine runs at a higher compression ratio.
